name: 19406 · Kng Of Prussa, PA
findings: ZIP 19406 (Kng Of Prussa) has 207 nonprofit organizations. 86 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 75 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 19406 (Kng Of Prussa) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
